gold.taskDescription: Research the real costs involved in living full-time on a sailboat, covering purchase, ongoing expenses, and lifestyle factors.

questions.title: What is your target budget for buying the sailboat?
questions.description: Understand the user's purchase budget range to scope the research appropriately.

questions.title: Are you researching to actually do this or just explore?
questions.description: Determine whether this is active planning or general curiosity, which affects the depth and urgency of research needed.

questions.title: Do you plan to stay in marinas or anchor out mostly?
questions.description: Marina fees vs. anchoring costs differ drastically and will shape the monthly expense breakdown.

questions.title: What country or sailing region are you targeting?
questions.description: Costs vary enormously between the US, Caribbean, Mediterranean, Southeast Asia, and other regions.

questions.title: Will you live aboard solo or with other people?
questions.description: The number of people affects boat size requirements, cost-sharing, and overall budget calculations.

questions.title: Do you intend to sail continuously or stay in one place?
questions.description: A cruising lifestyle has different fuel, provisioning, and maintenance costs than a stationary live-aboard setup.

questions.title: Do you have any sailing experience or boat ownership background?
questions.description: Prior experience determines whether costs like training, certification, or hiring crew need to be factored in.
